info.title: Needy Girl Overdose
info.synopsis: Ame-chan è una ragazza fragile che, per sfuggire alla solitudine e alle insicurezze, crea un alter ego online: la brillante e affettuosa OMGkawaiiAngel. Mentre davanti alla telecamera appare perfetta e solare, nella vita reale lotta con ansia, pressione e un crescente senso di vuoto. Il successo e l'affetto del pubblico diventano la sua unica fonte di conforto, ma anche la causa del suo tormento. Tra la ricerca di approvazione e la paura di perdere sé stessa, Ame si ritrova intrappolata in un mondo dove la popolarità è effimera e la felicità sembra sempre più lontana.

episodes.title: She`s a Killer Queen
episodes.synopsis: The girl who became a ray of light illuminating upon this chaotic internet of today... OMGkawaiiAngel. While the sensational KAngel's actions stir public opinion, the up-and-coming streaming group Karamazov keeps an eye on her. Meanwhile, Kache heads to work at a theme café. Here, a brand-new story about the Internet Angel begins.

episodes.title: Just the Two of Us
episodes.synopsis: Karamazov and AngeliKa perform live together, but things aren’t as perfect as they seem.

episodes.title: Internet Overdose
episodes.synopsis: When asked about the thoughts behind "INTERNET OVERDOSE," the girl reminisces. Memories of childhood, the words thrown at her: “What happens when people die?” This is the story of the passing days of a single girl.

episodes.title: London Calling
episodes.synopsis: Kache lives an ordinary life, while Michica deviates from the ordinary. Once, the two spent time together in the same space. The words they exchanged in middle school echo. And now, in reality, Kache is living with her freeloader boyfriend. What will Kache, living like an ordinary person, choose?

episodes.title: Whatever
episodes.synopsis: As Karamazov's first live performance, "Crime and Punishment," draws near, Kache, who has broken up with her freeloader boyfriend, heads to an apparel shop with the members of Karamazov. Then, in the city at night, the figure of a lone girl appears.

episodes.title: Turn Around and Count 2 Ten
episodes.synopsis: "I wanted to die in my teens. If I could end my life looking my most beautiful, I think that would be the best outcome." Michica Gokubara expounds on what beauty is.

episodes.title: Slip Inside This House
episodes.synopsis: While strolling through the bustling night streets, Nechika invites a lone girl, Ame, to a café. Despite Ame realizing that Nechika has discovered her true identity as OMGkawaiiAngel, she accepts Nechika's invitation, and they head to the café.

episodes.title: Absolute Ego Dance
episodes.synopsis: Praise and slander overwhelm KAngel as Karamazov's influence continues to grow.

episodes.title: Blue Monday
episodes.synopsis: Michica and Kache face off. Inside the middle school classroom, Michica finally voices the emotions she has been harboring for so long. Kache reaches out to her in response, "No matter what, we're still friends!"

episodes.title: Antichrist Superstar
episodes.synopsis: The live performance battle between KAngel and Karamazov begins. KAngel belts out "INTERNET OVERDOSE". Karamazov responds by unveiling…

episodes.title: Canon a 3 Violinis con Basso c. / Gigue
episodes.synopsis: True to Lollipop's words, KAngel crumbles. Is this reality? Or is this a delusion?

episodes.title: Internet Yamero
episodes.synopsis: Lollipop and Kache pay a visit to KAngel. Everyone ignored the fact that the colossal presence that exists on the other side of the screen was, in reality, nothing more than a solitary girl. Faced with this outcome, Lollipop…

episodes.title: Ez Do Dance
episodes.synopsis: This is a fairy tale brought about by an angel. What follows is a story about what happens after everyone quits the internet. What exactly is the internet to us? This is the epilogue about the girls who lived ordinary lives and slowly grew into adulthood.

info.title: Naruto Movie 03: I guardiani del Regno della Luna Crescente
info.synopsis: Naruto, Sakura, Rock Lee e Kakashi devono scortare una persona importante fino al suo paese d'origine, ma quella che sembrava una missione relativamente tranquilla, prenderà una piega ben più bellicosa, quando il gruppo si ritroverà a dover affrontare una rivolta nel paese di destinazione.

episodes.title: Complete Movie
episodes.synopsis: Naruto, Kakashi, Sakura, and Lee are sent to protect a prince during his trip around the world and see that he returns safely to his home in the Moon Country. The Moon Country happens to be really rich and as such the Prince tends to buy anything his heart desires, during his travels the Prince would come across a circus group that features a rare Sabre-toothed tiger that he just had to have. So he purchased the entire group. Suddenly a mission to protect just the spoiled prince that hardly listened to anything said, turns in to a mission to look after animals and a prince that doesn`t listen to what they say, and in the end somehow get them all back safely to their home country. All the while there are three mysterious Ninja wielding some frightening jutsu waiting for them. Why are they attacking them? What do they want with Team Kakashi!?!

info.title: The Frontier Lord Begins with Zero Subjects
info.synopsis: Dias ha rispettato la volontà dei suoi genitori aiutando gli altri e continuando a combattere sul campo di battaglia per tale scopo. Ora noto come "eroe salvatore" per via della sua lunga carriera militare, è stato premiato dal re con un vasto possedimento terriero. Dopo aver incontrato Alna, una ragazza munita di corna che vive in questo territorio, Dias inizia la sua nuova vita da lord.

episodes.title: The Frontier Lord and the Girl with the Blue Horn
episodes.synopsis: Dias is awarded a domain for his wartime service, but there's one small problem. Does anyone even live there?

episodes.title: The Frontier Lord and His First Visitor
episodes.synopsis: Dias settles into daily life with Alna, and little by little, people begin to come calling.

episodes.title: The Frontier Lord and the Strange Merchant
episodes.synopsis: The population of Nezrose slowly grows, including a few surprises courtesy of an unusual visitor.

episodes.title: The Frontier Lord and the Neighboring Lord
episodes.synopsis: Dias meets the new lord of the neighboring domain, and he learns there are many rumors about them both.

episodes.title: The Frontier Lord and the Assailants from the Desert
episodes.synopsis: Dias tries his hand at farming, and Eldan sends a caravan of gifts to help him establish his domain.

episodes.title: The Frontier Lord and the Twins` Prayer
episodes.synopsis: Senai and Ayhan want to secretly help Dias cultivate his field. Can a new arrival offer them a solution?

episodes.title: The Frontier Lord and the New Subjects
episodes.synopsis: Expectations are low for a new group of dogkin immigrants, but Dias has some ideas for how they'd be useful.

episodes.title: The Frontier Lord and the Grassland Battle
episodes.synopsis: Diane's plans quickly go awry when she launches an attack on Dias in his own domain.

episodes.title: The Frontier Lord and the Wedding
episodes.synopsis: Klaus and Canis have grown close, and an event must be held, even if Dias is oblivious.

episodes.title: The Frontier Lord and His Son and Daughters
episodes.synopsis: A bunch of new faces arrive at Iluk Village, but not many of them turn out to be total strangers.

episodes.title: The Frontier Lord and Alna`s Big Brother
episodes.synopsis: Zorg rushes home to save his sister Alna from the wicked domain lord, utterly unprepared for what awaits him.

episodes.title: The Frontier Lord and the Story That Began with Zero Subjects
episodes.synopsis: Eldan visits Dias' domain, and delivers a range of official tidings from the king.

info.title: Bubblegum Crisis 2
info.synopsis: Bubblegum Crash! si colloca dopo un anno dall'inizio della Crisi. GENOM sembra aver deciso di prendersi una pausa, ma una nuova ondata di crimini compiuti dai Boomer convince le Knight Sabers a tornare in azione dopo il breve periodo di inattività. Quale mistero c’è dietro i vari furti di componenti di un avanzatissimo sistema di intelligenze artificiali?

episodes.title: Illegal Army
episodes.synopsis: After taking time off, The Knight Sabers are back in action, thanks to a string of robberies performed by an evil organization called the Illegal Army, who takes up arms and destroys the peace in MegaTokyo.

episodes.title: Geo Climbers
episodes.synopsis: A new type of Boomer with advanced AI is stolen! Now it's up to the newly re-formed Knight Sabers to get it back! However, they'll have their hands full with a group of Combat Boomers headed by a criminal scientist who is vying for the end of the Sabers.

episodes.title: Meltdown
episodes.synopsis: Boomers all over MegaTokyo are rioting and throw the city into chaos. In order to stop this disaster, the Knight Sabers must locate the mastermind behind it all!

info.title: Full Clearing Another World under a Goddess with Zero Believers
info.synopsis: Quando la sua classe resta sepolta viva sulla via del ritorno da una gita, il diciottenne Makoto Takatsuki viene trasportato in un altro mondo assieme a tutti loro. Tuttavia, se il resto dei suoi compagni ha acquisito potenti abilità, lui a malapena ha qualche potere. Una bellissima divinità che non ha fedeli è stata imprigionata, ed aspetta qualcuno che vada a salvarla. Nel frattempo incombe la minaccia del risveglio del re dei demoni. A Makoto non resta che salvare la dea e farsi strada in questo isekai costellato di avversità!

episodes.title: Makoto Takatsuki Becomes a Believer
episodes.synopsis: Makoto awakens with weak Stats & Unique Skills that seem useless, but he meets a goddess after venturing out.

episodes.title: Makoto Takatsuki Challenges a Quest
episodes.synopsis: Makoto visits Fujiyan to appraise the goddess' dagger, then begins his life as an adventurer slaying goblins.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.synopsis: Makoto gains his first party member. They hunt goblins, train, and then go hunt bison with Jean and Emily.
